description: This file contains utility functions for the Home module of vtiger CRM, including functions to retrieve upcoming and pending activities, generate activity entries for display, and get user-specific home page layout settings.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: A class for handling date and time formatting and conversions within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: homepage_getUpcomingActivities
methods.description: Retrieves upcoming activities for today, limited by maxval, and optionally returns the count.

methods.name: homepage_getPendingActivities
methods.description: Retrieves pending activities for today, limited by maxval, and optionally returns the count.

methods.name: getActivityEntries
methods.description: Generates an array of activity entries formatted for display, including links and styling based on priority.

methods.name: getNumberOfColumns
methods.description: Returns the number of home page layout columns for the current user, defaulting to 4.
